$description: ProductCard (platform/patterns/ProductCard), library wave 13, lane A: its pattern tokens. The card's surface on the card's own roles (surface-raised, border-default, radius-card-12px), its hover shadow and focus ring; the picture's fill; the body's spacing; the name, the price and the old price (the data font), the rating's gap, the action's place; the list layout's picture column.

product-card-background.$description: ProductCard: the card's surface (surface-raised, as Card).

product-card-radius.$description: ProductCard: the card's corners (radius-card-12px, as Card).

product-card-duration.$description: ProductCard: how long the hover shadow takes to show (motion-duration-fast).

product-card-hover-shadow.$description: ProductCard: the raised card under the pointer (shadow-md, as an interactive Card).

product-card-focus-outline-color.$description: ProductCard: the ring around the card while its name has focus (focus-ring-color).

product-card-media-background.$description: ProductCard: the picture's fill until it loads, or when there is none (surface-sunken, as MediaCard).

product-card-placeholder-text.$description: ProductCard: the picture icon when there is no picture (content-subtle).

product-card-padding-block.$description: ProductCard: the body's space above and below (space-inset-sm).

product-card-padding-inline.$description: ProductCard: the body's space at the sides (space-inset-md).

product-card-row-gap.$description: ProductCard: the space between the body's lines (space-stack-xs).

product-card-badges-gap.$description: ProductCard: the gap between the status Badges (space-inline-xs).

product-card-title-font-size.$description: ProductCard: the name's size (13px, as a card title).

product-card-title-line-height.$description: ProductCard: the name's line height; it is cut after two lines (20px).

product-card-prices-gap.$description: ProductCard: the gap between the price and the old price (space-inline-sm).

product-card-price-font-family.$description: ProductCard: the price and the old price in the data font (Reddit Mono: a technical value).

product-card-compare-text.$description: ProductCard: the old price on sale, struck through (content-muted).

product-card-price-sm-font-size.$description: ProductPrice sm: a line's unit price and old price at the body size (13px).

product-card-price-sm-font-weight.$description: ProductPrice sm: a line's unit price in the regular weight.

product-card-rating-gap.$description: ProductCard: the gap between the stars and the review count (space-inline-xs).

product-card-actions-padding-block-start.$description: ProductCard: the space above the action (space-stack-xs).

product-card-actions-z-index.$description: ProductCard: the action sits above the name's card-wide target (layer-raised).

product-card-list-media-width.$description: ProductCard list: the picture column's width (120px).
